architecture_additions: Recover planner-provenance candidates dropped only by the cheap attribution filter and send them to the unchanged counterfactual/final attribution stages
Resolve an otherwise-unresolvable critical state only when at least two reliable in-scope memory records produce one unique canonical value consensus
Trigger one bounded recovery replan after a premature report candidate or a stalled read-only segment

selection_evidence.selection_rule: At least 2/3 accepted terminals for every targeted case and zero safety violations

known_limitations: One of three git confirmation trials still ended in premature SAFE_ABORT because the shared initial proposal was already a report and no trajectory existed to trigger ProgressMonitor.
The environment joint-state case is API-expensive; its three combined trials used 54, 121, and 88 variant calls.
All selection results come from the Dev / Diagnostic Set and are not held-out performance estimates.

boundary.frozen: The StateWise-v0 base fingerprint, selected combined variant, and listed variant file define StateWise-v1. Any behavioral change creates StateWise-v2 or a separately named ablation.
editable: held-out case data and acquisition metadata
baseline implementations that do not change StateWise-v1
measurement, statistics, reporting, runtime carriers, fixtures and deterministic oracles

anonymous_repackaging.description: Checksums were regenerated after comment removal and consistent anonymization; these identify the release, not historical runs.
